content:
But again the lord of men, Agamemnon, spoke to him:
“I am glad, son of Laertes, having heard your speech;
for you set forth and ordered all things rightly.
These things I desire to swear — my heart urges me —
and I will not break an oath before a god. But let Achilles
remain here, though he be eager as if stirred by Ares.
You others, meanwhile, hold back, scattered, until the gifts
come from the ship and we cut the faithful oaths.
And to you myself I command and enjoin this:
choosing as escort the best champions of all the Achaeans,
to bring my gifts from the ship to Achilles, which yesterday
we undertook to give him, and to lead the women off.
And let Talthybius quickly through the broad host of the Achaeans
prepare a boar and cut it up for sacrifice to Zeus and to Helios.”
